## Design

### 2026-10-06 — I almost got lost (my

**0.37h**

I almost got lost (my

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/BRayDag2WR1coxLPSizt1Mn7PAUSSVJ0/1da263aec97ed95440beaba010ec478879c5dfb4ee1c81284710b093c32dc01b.png)

 first time using KiCad).

This is the first time in months I’ve used something other than Fusion 360; I’m not used to it, but I think I can pull it off. I mean, how hard can it be? If so many people can do it, I can too, right? (How do I add GND? Help!)

Honestly, it doesn't look all that complex, though it will take some time to learn properly. I need to know how to connect things correctly—I don't want to end up with a poorly designed PCB that fries my components. I want my "Starbie" to have style, so I plan to make the PCB look really aesthetic and organized.
